subject: Riverside Roadshow — last-minute network outage & battery swap plan
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@riverside-events.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Riverside Logistics <ops@riverside-events.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T07:18:00-08:00
Subject: Urgent - partial power trip on Dockside Hall A (impact to exhibitor power & Wi-Fi)

Connor,

Quick heads up — we had a partial electrical circuit trip on the Dockside Hall A riser at ~06:40. The building team has isolated the fault but that took out a subset of outlet clusters and the primary Wi‑Fi AP for the east floor.

Impacted: booths A12–A20 (includes Redwood demo island). Event doors still open; we expect venue lighting and house sound to be okay but some exhibitor power is unstable and the east AP is flapping (intermittent SSID).

We escalated to our on-call electrician and battery/UPS crew. ETA is currently 35–50 minutes. I wanted to alert you as soon as we knew. If you need us to prioritize a single exhibitor for power or enable a temporary wired drop, tell us and we’ll push it to the front of the queue.

Apologies for the disruption — I’ll send updates as soon as I have a confirmed ETA for the crew.

— Alex
Alex Turner
Operations Manager, Riverside Events
ph: (415) 555-0142
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex@riverside-events.com>, TechWave Support <support@techwave.io>
Date: 2026-11-09T07:25:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Urgent - partial power trip on Dockside Hall A (impact to exhibitor power & Wi-Fi)

Thanks Alex — appreciate the quick heads up. Team, conclusive asks below, we need to move fast: 

1) Priority: keep the Redwood demo live for the next 90 minutes (peak traffic window). If venue can only prioritize one exhibitor for power, request Dockside A12.

2) Backup network: can TechWave stage 6x LTE hotspots at our island and hand us pre-provisioned SIMs? If battery units are arriving we may need to chain UPS->battery->edge router.

3) Speaker contingency: Dr. Anika Rao is scheduled for noon. If venue AV is degraded we need a remote-RTMP fallback (capture from laptop -> Redwood stream). Marissa, can you coordinate the telepresence option and ask Anika for a live Zoom + slide deck ASAP?

4) Logistics: Marcus — arrange a quick physical run to the site to collect the onsite ethernet key and a spare PoE injector. If you can grab a portable battery (1000W) from our Van C and meet venue ops, do that.

I’m copying Alex and TechWave so they can confirm ETA on power crew and hotspot availability. I’ll hold on public comms until we have a short mitigation plan to announce to attendees.

— Connor
Connor O'Brien
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference

Copy. Quick notes: 
- I have the vendor list for UPS/battery rentals; local partner TechWave is listed with 30–45 min SLA for on-site units (we've used them before at SXSW). I pinged their support.
- For RTMP: we should use a dual-path — Zoom for interaction + RTMP to venue LED as fallback. If Wi‑Fi is unstable, RTMP should route over the LTE hotspots.
- Attach: I exported the minimal hotspot provisioning steps (see attachment). Marcus, take the company LTE router key from the van and keep it in your hand.

Short follow-up: if venue will allow a single hardwired run, ask them to give us the nearest floor port to A12; that buys us stability even without the AP.

— Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex@riverside-events.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T07:42:00-08:00
Subject: URGENT: talk options for today (Riverside Roadshow)

Hi Anika — short note: the venue reported a partial power/network issue this morning that may affect AV. We have two quick fallbacks and want to confirm your preference: 

A) In-person as planned — we will prioritize a hardwired run and battery-backed power at your stage. Please confirm you’ll still arrive on-site.
B) Remote: join via Zoom at 11:55 PT; we’ll request a short Q&A window afterwards. We can run your deck from your laptop or host slides from our Drive.

If you choose remote, can you send the final slide deck (pptx/pdf) by 09:30 PT and confirm your Zoom name/email? We’ll provide a dedicated Slack channel for coordination.

Thanks — we’re aiming for minimal attendee disruption.

— Marissa
Senior Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Connor / Alex,

We can be on-site with 6x LTE hotspots (pre-provisioned SIMs) and 2x 1200W battery packs in ~28 minutes. Tech notes attached (battery_unit_manifest.pdf, venue_wifi_diagnostics_1109.txt). We'll hand off PoE injectors and a spare edge router config via USB. 

We recommend: one hardwired run to A12 (if venue allows) + two LTE hotspots bonded for the demo island. For presenter streaming, route RTMP over the bonded LTE and mirror to venue display. We’ll also leave one hotspot at registration for general attendee fallback.

Confirm if we should stage at your van or enter through Dock B (we prefer Dock B for loading).

— Support Team

- TechWave confirmed 6x LTE hotspots + 2x 1200W battery packs, ETA ~28 minutes; staging at Dock B accepted.
